cards.title: COIN COUNTER
cards.concept: counting-house clerk in a grey wool vest and sleeve garters, holding a wooden abacus at his chest with neat stacks of silver coins at his shoulder, glasses and a bright smile.
cards.hook: Head of Growth & Capital Markets: his first job in the realm is counting the treasury.

cards.title: HERBALIST
cards.concept: village herbalist in a plain grey linen apron with a leather satchel of pressed leaves, raising a brass magnifying glass beside his glasses to study a sprig.
cards.hook: Biology degree from Pitzer: the naturalist before the biotech career.

cards.title: TOWN CRIER
cards.concept: cheerful town crier in a grey tabard and felt cap, ringing a brass handbell with a rolled news scroll tucked under his arm, mid-smile.
cards.hook: Marketing and investor relations, plus his bright upbeat energy: he is the one who announces the news.

cards.title: QUARTERMASTER
cards.concept: guild quartermaster in a grey leather jerkin, a ring of iron keys on his belt strap and a wax-tablet inventory held to his chest, pencil behind the ear.
cards.hook: COO at Vesicor Therapeutics: the person who keeps the whole operation stocked and running.

cards.title: TAVERN DEALMAKER
cards.concept: tavern dealmaker in a neat grey waistcoat and cravat, holding up a wax-sealed parchment contract and a quill with a confident grin.
cards.hook: Public-market M&A: closing deals is his everyday trade, suit-and-tie polish even in a tavern.

cards.title: GREENBACK TRADER
cards.concept: travelling merchant in a green-trimmed hooded cloak, a small brass balance scale held at his chest with a green coin purse hanging from it.
cards.hook: Capital markets, with a greenback pun on the green tier.

cards.title: NATURALIST RANGER
cards.concept: ranger-naturalist in a moss-green cloak and leather bracers, holding a specimen jar with a tiny glowing beetle while a little green frog familiar sits on his shoulder.
cards.hook: Biology degree from Pitzer, now out in the field.

cards.title: GROWTH BARD
cards.concept: smiling bard in a green feathered cap and doublet, strumming a lute at his chest as a small sprouting vine curls up its neck.
cards.hook: Head of Growth plus marketing: he grows audiences with a song, matching his upbeat vibe.

cards.title: BULL TAMER
cards.concept: young rancher in a green bandana and leather vest with a friendly bull calf familiar peeking over his shoulder, a coiled lasso held at his chest.
cards.hook: Public markets: an optimist who keeps the bull market close and on his side.

cards.title: BIO-ALCHEMIST
cards.concept: alchemist in a teal-lined lab robe with brass goggles pushed up over his hair, holding a bubbling teal flask with a faint glowing double helix swirling inside.
cards.hook: Biotech career (Vesicor Therapeutics COO) and biology training.

cards.title: ROYAL ENVOY
cards.concept: polished royal envoy in a tailored dark doublet with a teal sash and cravat like a suit and tie, presenting a treaty scroll whose teal wax seal glows faintly.
cards.hook: Investor relations: the diplomat who speaks for the house to its investors, with his suit-and-tie polish.

cards.title: VOYAGER CAPTAIN
cards.concept: merchant-galleon captain in a teal-trimmed tricorn and long coat, a spyglass raised by his cheek and a brass compass glowing teal at his chest.
cards.hook: VP of M&A at Voyager Acquisition Corp: charting a course to the next acquisition.

cards.title: GRAND TRANSMUTER
cards.concept: grand transmuter in ornate violet robes with glowing magenta runes, hands raised as a floating lead ingot turns to gold inside a blazing violet transmutation circle behind his head.
cards.hook: Growth and capital markets: turning ventures into value.

cards.title: ELIXIR SAGE
cards.concept: arcane sage in a high-collared violet mantle, raising a radiant magenta elixir of life to his chest while a glowing DNA-helix vine coils around his shoulders, eyes lit violet behind his glasses.
cards.hook: Biotech COO and biology degree: master of the elixir of life.

cards.title: PHOENIX OF FORTUNE
cards.concept: ascended phoenix lord in gold-and-white regalia cut like a ceremonial suit and tie, a radiant crown above his short hair, vast golden flame wings rising behind him with gold coins and a shining gold DNA helix spiralling upward, beaming his bright smile.
cards.hook: Everything at once: growth that rises again and again, capital markets gold, and his biology roots, lit by his trademark smile.
